The Network pair (1/1, 1/2) and the Access four (2/1-2/4) are separate blocks under their own bracketed legends. The jacks are common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 turned 180 (lamp windows in the upper corners, green and amber in the render) on the part's 13.97 pitch, centred on each block as measured (57.55 and 112.6); the render's own jack pitch reads 13.6-13.9 at 3.3 px/mm. The cages are std/sfp-ganged@1 at the registry's 14.25 pitch on the same block centres; the render's cage openings read 14.0, which a 14.25-wide part cannot sit on without overlapping, so the difference is in the drawing, not hidden. The printed numbers sit about 2.8 mm left of their jacks, as in the render."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"AC 100-240 V, 50/60 Hz / DC -24 to -72 V (dual-feed)\"; \"Power Consumption Typical 25 W, Max 45 W\", with no configuration or ambient stated.
